structured.answer: If I go ahead at all, I'd open the account with Psagot and buy the first fund, "אי.בי.אי. מחקה (4A) ת"א 125" (5112628). The page says that leaves "86,045 ₪" on "70,000 ₪" paid in. But it says "בעוד 15 שנים" in one place and 120 months in another, so before I sign anything I'll ask my son or the bank.

stuck.why: Under 86,045 it says 'נשאר לכם בעוד 15 שנים', but above it says '120 חודשים'. I couldn't tell if it's ten years or fifteen.
Every fund has a minus (−0.04%, −1,030 ₪) and I thought they were losing money. Only at the bottom of screen 8 did a sentence say the minus means 'פיגרה אחרי המדד'.
'−1,030 ₪ לעומת הבחירה שלכם' with a minus made me back away without understanding it.

findings.what: It says 'בעוד 15 שנים' next to a 10-year calculation (120 months). I don't know which to believe.
Minus signs on every fund, and the explanation only comes much further down, in small print. Scary.
The page opens with English letters and the word מדד without explaining it. Someone like me would leave on the first screen.
Dark background with grey text, hard to read even enlarged
findings.where: The whole page, especially the small print under the headings
